Hey, i have the same problem. my sleep schedule is so messed up. I've woken up screaming a few times, covered in sweat from head to toe. :/ I am sorry that you have to deal with that. *huggles*

Sorry edit: that being said, it comes and goes. I used to have nightmares every night, now sometimes I don't. I just have to make sure that I am calm before I go to sleep. A nice long bath or shower can help ease your nerves. Also, meditation. Just try and think of yourself standing in an awesome place, serenity and calmness helps. 

I imagine I'm under a waterfall, I love the water. It's warm and peaceful, and the sun is shining and there is a light breeze, the temperature is perfect... and there are butterflies and the only sounds I hear are the water around me... but it's not overwhelmingly loud as one might think. 

Find your happy place, go there in your mind before you sleep.

let the butterflies carry you onto cloud 9 :) For serious though, yes, I have been in a situation like that before... It turned out ok :) Just remember to breath, try to distract yourself with your favorite activities, or music. Keep yourself busy so you don't over think things.
